map.由关节角求末端执行器坐标。: Find the end effector coordinates from the joint angles.
map.θ₁=30°、θ₂=45°、L=1 → 约 (1.297, 1.207)。: θ₁ = 30° and θ₂ = 45° with L = 1 give about (1.297, 1.207).
map.已知关节角求末端坐标。: Find the end coordinates from known joint angles.
map.θ1=θ2=0 → 末端 (2,0)，恰为 r_max。: θ1 = θ2 = 0 puts the end at (2,0), exactly r_max.
map.是第二连杆相对第一连杆的夹角，绝对角=θ1+θ2。: Yes, it is the angle of the second link relative to the first, so the absolute angle is θ1 + θ2.
map.正运动学单值；逆运动学可能多解或不可达。: Forward kinematics is single valued, while inverse kinematics can have several solutions or none at all.
